meta.title: Assisteo Agny
meta.description: Snap a photo, the AI explains what you're looking at.

scan.headline: What are we

modeHints.auto: The AI figures out what's in the photo on its own.
modeHints.food: Estimated nutrition, storage tips and recipe ideas.
modeHints.document: Key points, important dates and things to do.
modeHints.vehicle: Prices, specs, maintenance and what to watch for.

scan.demoBody: No AI key is configured on the server, so the AI doesn’t look at your photos. Add GEMINI_API_KEY (free) or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to .env.local and restart the server.
scan.webIntro: Drop a photo of a meal, a document or an object: the AI explains what it is and what you can do with it.
scan.dropHint: or paste it with Ctrl+V · JPG, PNG, WebP
scan.how1: Pick the kind of subject, or let the AI guess.
scan.how2: Drop, paste or snap your image.
scan.how3: Get facts, tips and reminders, saved to your history.
scan.pickHint: First choose what you’re photographing, then retake the photo.

errors.title: The analysis didn't go through
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Lots of requests right now. Give it a few seconds.
errors.refused: This image can't be analysed. Try another photo.
errors.unavailable: The AI service is unavailable right now.
errors.upstream_error: The AI returned an incomplete answer. Try again.
errors.camera: The camera isn't accessible. Allow it in your phone settings.
errors.billing: The AI account has no credit left. Add credit at console.anthropic.com or switch back to demo mode.
errors.invalid_key: Your API key was rejected. Check it in Settings → AI engine.
errors.trial_exhausted: Your free trial is over. Add your own API key in Settings → AI engine to continue.
errors.server_busy: The free AI has reached today's limit. Add your own key (Gemini is free) or come back tomorrow.

result.reminderDenied: Turn on notifications to get reminders.
result.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted from this device.
result.demoNote: Sample answer: in demo mode the AI did not analyse your photo.
result.vehiclePriceNote: Rough ranges estimated by the AI: prices vary with country, year and condition.
result.uncertainBody: A sharper, well-lit photo, or the right scan type, gives a better answer.

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: Your analyses will show up here. They are only stored on your device.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notifyOnResultHint: Get notified when an analysis finishes in the background.
settings.notificationsDenied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your system settings.
settings.testBody: Assisteo Agny can send you reminders.
settings.storage: {count} analyses · {size} of photos on this device
settings.storageHint: To save space, only the {count} most recent analyses keep their full-size photo; older ones keep a smaller one.
settings.privacy: Photos are sent to the AI for analysis and are not kept on our server. Without an account, history stays on your device.
settings.permissionDeniedHint: To turn a denied permission back on, open your phone settings → Apps → Assisteo Agny.
settings.aiServerHint: Analyses use the server’s AI. Pick a provider to use your own key: Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, Mistral, Groq, OpenRouter… or any OpenAI-compatible API.
settings.aiUseServer: Switch back to the server’s AI

aiKeyErrors.invalid_key: This key was rejected. Check it’s complete and matches the selected provider.
aiKeyErrors.billing: The key is valid but the account has no credit.
aiKeyErrors.rate_limited: The key is valid but its quota is used up for now. Try later or pick another model.
aiKeyErrors.model_unavailable: This model doesn’t exist or isn’t available with this key.
aiKeyErrors.overloaded: The service is overloaded right now. Your key isn’t the problem: try again in a moment, or pick a lighter model (for example Flash-Lite).

settings.aiKeyPrivacy: Your key stays on this device (the phone’s secure storage). It’s only sent when you run an analysis and never kept on the server.
settings.aiBaseUrlHint: An OpenAI-compatible API over https. The address often ends with /v1.
settings.aiModelHint: Pick a model that understands images (vision). “Load models” lists the ones your key can use.
settings.aiModelsLoaded: {count} models available with this key. Type to filter.

sidebar.installBody: Add Assisteo Agny to your computer and open it like an app.
sidebar.mobileApps: Also available on Android and iOS.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Before we start, Assisteo Agny will ask for access to a few phone features. For each one we explain what it’s for: you can accept, decline, and change your mind any time.
onboarding.cameraBody: It’s the heart of the app: to analyse something, you need to take a photo of it or pick an image.
cameraReasons: Snap a meal, a document or an object
Pick a photo you already took from your gallery
onboarding.cameraPrivacy: Photos are only used for the analysis and never kept on our servers.
onboarding.notificationsBody: So we can let you know at the right time, without keeping the app open.
notificationsReasons: Know when an analysis is ready
Get your reminders: food to finish, a bill to pay, a plant to water
onboarding.denied: Access denied. You can turn it on later in your phone settings, under Apps.
onboarding.doneBody: You can change these permissions any time in Settings.

trial.overBody: You’ve used your {limit} free analyses. To keep going, add your own API key: Gemini gives free keys in two minutes.
trial.settingsLeft: Free trial: {remaining} of {limit} analyses left on the server’s AI.
trial.settingsOver: Your free trial is over. Add your Gemini (free) or Claude key to continue.

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Server settings, applied immediately to every app.
admin.disabled: Admin is disabled: set ADMIN_TOKEN on the server.
admin.notDurable: No Redis database is connected: these settings and trial counts will be lost on the next server restart.
admin.limitHint: Analyses offered on the server’s AI before users must add their own key. 0 = no trial.
admin.askLimitHint: Questions about a scan on the server’s AI. Unlimited with an own key.
admin.dailyLimitHint: Scans + questions on the server's key, all users together (0 = no cap). Today: {used}.
admin.appSubtitle: Block incompatible old versions or suggest the update.
admin.minimumHint: Below it, the app is blocked until updated. Empty = none.
admin.latestHint: Below it, a banner suggests updating. Empty = nothing.

account.signedOutBody: Sign in to get your history, settings and API key on all your devices.
account.title: Sign in
account.body: Your history, settings and API key will follow you on your phone and on the web.
account.noPassword: No password: we send you a one-time code.
account.checkSpam: Nothing yet? Check your spam folder.
account.signedOut: Signed out. Your data stays in your account.
account.offline: Offline: will sync when back online
account.signOutHint: This device will be cleared (history and API key). Everything stays in your account and comes back when you sign in again.
account.deleteBody: Your history, photos, settings and API key will be erased from our servers and from this device. This can't be undone.
account.deleted: Your account and data have been deleted.
account.deleteFailed: Deletion failed. Check your connection and try again.

errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute before asking for a new code.
errors.invalid_code: Wrong code. Check it or ask for a new one.
errors.expired_code: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.

reminders.title: Set a reminder
reminders.past: Pick a moment in the future.
reminders.defaultBody: You asked to be reminded about this.
reminders.insuranceBody: Your insurance expires on {date}, in {days} days. Remember to renew it.
reminders.insuranceNotice: Automatic reminder on {date}, {days} days before the {expiry} expiry. It can’t be turned off.

chat.title: A question about this scan?
chat.intro: Ask anything: the AI looks at the photo and its analysis again to answer.
chat.limit: You’ve used all of today’s questions on the server’s AI. Add your own API key to continue, or come back tomorrow.

document: What do I need to do, and by when?
vehicle: How much is maintenance per year?
What should I check before buying?
What’s the fuel use in town?
object: How do I take care of it?
plant: How often should I water it?
Why are its leaves turning yellow?
Is it toxic to my cat?

legal.consent: By continuing, you accept the {terms} and the {privacy}.

update.requiredBody: This version of Assisteo Agny is no longer compatible. Install the new version to continue: your history is kept.
update.noLink: Download the latest version from where you installed the app.
